review.reviewNotes: Four distinct complete Keeg block poses map to the four source cells. Pose2 reaches up with an open empty hand for the apex at tick5; the arm stays beside and clear of the very tall purple hat, silver trim and mushroom details. Keeg remains an adult human with black hair, close black beard, complete hat, natural anatomy and purple/lavender/silver kit. All silhouettes are inside their own cells; hands contain no ball. The live basketball remains an independent game object. Canon K.03 approves mirroring.
